title: ReplicaPeer
description: Per-peer replica row for a CID's distribution-details view. Source of truth: peer_identity_bindings (Category A from imagodei DHT, projected via signal stream) joined with libp2p swarm liveness (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

deviceArchetype.description: Hardware/deployment archetype carried on the AgentPeerBinding.

lastSeenSeconds.description: Seconds since this peer was last observed online.

hopHint.description: Approximate libp2p Kad hop distance from the requester.

householdId.description: Household this peer belongs to, when known.

regionTier.description: Coarse region tier (e.g. 'us-central') for diversity reasoning.
